facts.fact: The Banque de la Republique du Burundi launched BurundiPay on 23 April 2026, a national instant payment system linking commercial banks, microfinance institutions and payment operators, per Agence Ecofin as cited by Yaga Burundi.

systems.owner: Banque de la Republique du Burundi

BDI.note: Nothing on civil servant digital skills.
Nothing on consumer rules or redress for digital finance.
Digital salary and benefit payment is only proposed by the author, not stated as in service.

systems.system: Operator reports of power cuts several times a day

BDI.note: Only an internet penetration rate of about 30 per cent is given, which is not a share of people using the internet.
Nothing on local government revenue records.
Mobile money use of 11 per cent (AERC, 2024) is not an adult account share.

facts.fact: Yaga Burundi says BurundiPay, launched 23 April 2026, lets users send and pay in real time from a bank account or a mobile wallet, with banks, microfinance institutions and payment operators on one interoperable network.
Yaga Burundi says BurundiPay, launched by the central bank on 23 April 2026, is a national instant payment system working from bank accounts and mobile wallets, including by USSD on basic phones.
A 2024 AERC study cited by Yaga Burundi put mobile money use in Burundi at 11 per cent.

systems.owner: Banque de la Republique du Burundi

BDI.note: Paying taxes by phone is only proposed, not stated as in service.
